profile_text.body:
The Alignment Research Center, which goes by ARC, is a non-profit research organization founded in 2021 and based in Berkeley, California. Its stated mission is to align future machine learning systems with human interests. The organization describes itself as expecting that new techniques will be needed to align AI systems as they surpass human capabilities, and it argues that progress in AI may outpace the ability to adapt to it. ARC says the field would be better prepared with methods that can be safely scaled across many orders of magnitude, in the way generative pretraining and reinforcement learning have been scaled up over the past decade.

The material available on the organization is limited to that mission and motivation. No products are listed for ARC, and no lawsuits involving it are recorded.
